summary: Nearshoring is creating waves in transportation. In this issue of The Road to Success, read more about why industries are moving closer to home.
body_markdown:
Nearshoring is creating waves in transportation. In this issue of **The Road to Success®** , read more about why industries are moving closer to home and how Landstar offers cross-border solutions many manufacturers need.


### Plus...


- A "Solution in Motion" powered by the Landstar network
- Ideas for fighting off loneliness on the road
- How Landstar's Contractors' Advantage Purchasing Program (LCAPP) is saving owner-operators thousands
